prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years designing and delivering full-stack platforms, business automation tools, and AI-agent workflows. Built production-grade applications from serverless edge infrastructure to multi-agent automation, emphasizing low overhead and disciplined operations.

bullets.text: Architected and deployed linkme-intops, a CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, cutting service delivery times by over 30%.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that transforms business URLs into shoppable 3D scroll demos in about one minute using Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2, and D1.
Designed a six-stage agent pipeline with Interpretable Context Methodology, automating verification to prevent hallucinated pricing and claims.
Engineered tycodes.dev on edge infrastructure with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind on Cloudflare Workers and a Hono Worker running Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audit and pricing models.
Designed zero-maintenance serverless backends that use Google Sheets via OAuth, eliminating dedicated server costs.
Led end-to-end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, reducing manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Constructed database-layer automated validation pipelines that removed 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Secured 50+ qualified meetings per month, surpassing a daily quota of two and setting a record of 120+ booked meetings in a single month.
Mentored and onboarded new representatives, helping them achieve conversion rates above 15%.
Managed $100M+ of federal inventory across 12 sites serving over 8,000 personnel daily, maintaining 100% audit accuracy while cutting processing times by 35%.
